stem:
Meera's class is discussing the changes seen in children as they grow older. Which of the following statements about adolescence is incorrect ( )
A. Adolescence is the stage of human life between childhood and adulthood
B. Adolescence generally lasts from about 10 to 19 years of age
C. The body must already be reproductively mature before adolescence begins
D. Growth and reproductive maturity develop gradually during adolescence

options.text: Adolescence is the stage of human life between childhood and adulthood
Adolescence generally lasts from about 10 to 19 years of age
The body must already be reproductively mature before adolescence begins
Growth and reproductive maturity develop gradually during adolescence

teacher.key_rationale: Adolescence is defined as the stage between childhood and adulthood, generally from about 10 to 19 years, during which growth and reproductive maturity develop gradually; therefore A, B and D are correct. Reproductive maturity develops during adolescence, not before it, so C is the incorrect statement and the required answer.
